1. Download the game's APK and OBB file(s) on the headset, or copy them from a USB drive / Android phone using the Files app.

2. Open krxzyinstall and allow the two permissions. File access lets it read your downloads; install access lets it install APKs and write the game's OBB folder.

3. krxzyinstall scans Downloads and groups the APK with OBBs that match its package name and version. Tap a game, check the files, and press Install.

4. Android always shows one system confirmation before installing an APK. Tap Install. krxzyinstall then moves or copies the OBB files to:

Android/obb/<package.name>/

5. Launch the game from the result screen, or find it in your library under Unknown Sources.

No PC, USB debugging, ADB, root, or developer mode is required. Files never leave the headset.

Only install files you trust and have the right to use.
